name: CoBeing v1.2.0
body:
## CoBeing v1.2.0

### New Features
- Master Registry - unified Agent/Group registry
- Group lifecycle management (active -> completed -> archived)
- Voting & consensus mechanism
- Task dependency management (dependsOn chains)
- Agent external workspace binding
- Observability dashboard
- Provider auto-fallback
- Theme system redesign (6 themes)
- TODO kanban board + batch operations
- Meta-skills system
- MiMo Provider

### Changes
- Providers: 11 -> 7 (DeepSeek/Zhipu/Qwen/MiniMax/Volcengine/Moonshot/MiMo)
- Channel: QQBot only
- Removed forced .env configuration on first launch
- Tutorial redesigned with proper spacing

### Prerequisites
- Node.js >= 22, pnpm >= 10
- Extract, run `pnpm install`, double-click `start.bat`
